ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity zones occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edges, lateral tips, and the central peduncle area. A distinct, isolated low-intensity circular cluster is located in the lower-medial quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped convergence; vertex angle approximately 48 degrees, base partially occluded by water spray turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude (5-15 pixel depth) jagged serrations. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits lower-frequency, smoother undulations with amplitudes under 5 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Leading edges follow a symmetric convex upward curvature from the peduncle, terminating in sharp, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) scattered across the high-intensity regions of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent low-intensity diagonal linear feature on the right lobe medial section; multiple short, parallel vertical linear disruptions on the left lobe proximal to the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular material loss and jagged indentations along the trailing edge of the right lobe, indicating significant physical trauma compared to the smoother left lobe boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'feathered' pigmentation pattern consisting of dark rake-like extensions branching inward from the upper trailing edge of the right lobe.
